verdict_reason: No public parcel-level enrolment register found for cover-crop/tillage programmes. Agreena confirms enrolment data is login-gated (aggregate hectares/farmer counts only, no field geometries). Klim's register and CAP/national LPIS eco-scheme layers were unreachable this session (404/refused/JS-rendered), and CAP reporting is known to be aggregate-only. No treatment group is obtainable.

ground_truth.construction_protocol: No public protocol exists. Enrolment is proprietary to platform operators (Agreena, Klim), gated behind farmer/partner login; CAP eco-scheme uptake is aggregate-only, not parcel geometries. Requires a private data-sharing agreement, not a public source.

notes: WebSearch was exhausted session-wide before any query executed; verification relied solely on direct WebFetch of known/guessed landing pages. Failed fetches (Denmark, Austria, EC eco-scheme page, Klim) are inconclusive, not proof of non-existence, and should be re-checked with working search access. The confirmed Agreena fetch plus CAP's well-documented aggregate-only transparency reporting are the strongest basis for the blocked verdict.
